Interface GroupResponse

All Known Implementing Classes:
BentoBoxGroupResponse, BetterTeamsGroupResponse, FactionsBridgeGroupResponse, FactionsUUIDGroupResponse, HuskTownsGroupResponse, KingdomsGroupResponse, LandsGroupResponse, McMMOGroupResponse, PartiesGroupResponse, PlaceholderGroupResponse, SimpleClansGroupResponse, SuperiorSkyblockGroupResponse, TownyGroupResponse
public interface GroupResponse
The response when querying a group from GroupProvider. Contains the error getter, the handled boolean method, and the Group interface object.
